keyEvents.text: Javi Montero (Leganes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Naim García (Leganes) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Trival Valderas 0, Leganes 1. Álex Millán (Leganes) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Naim García.
Iván López (Trival Valderas) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Suleiman El Haddadi Mohamed (Leganés) Substitution at 71'
Yoan Bayano Zibi (Trival Valderas) Substitution at 78'
Tanke (Trival Valderas) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Raúl Díez (Trival Valderas) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
